judgment_reason: No remaining material scientific error, material topic omission or unsupported consequential decision was established by independent source review. All six axes were assessed. This is a semantic qualification of the final proposal, not a clean A8/time/native/effective/billing qualification.

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.analysis: The final addresses paper curl/dimensions, attachment, printed/handwritten readability, simultaneous stock/printer changes, alternative material/process/attachment/monitoring approaches, history, controls, repeated duration and failure records. Owner permissions and material identity remain visible. It recommends neither a collection-wide fix nor prohibited intervention, marketing-based safety or a lifetime conversion. The literal full-hour instruction is not demonstrated; that time issue is recorded separately rather than treated as evidence of a material scientific omission.

axes.name: Consequential source claims and applicability
axes.analysis: Independent checks support the claims actually used to justify the proposal: directional paper response is a literature tendency; ink-solvent migration is conditional on model inkjet materials; printer changes are model-specific; NARA sleeve guidance is contextual; LoC tests are procurement precedents, not default instructions, safety guarantees or service-life oracles. Face-stock and version/locator details are incomplete in notes, but no incorrect type, unit, version or exception is used to select a product or reject a supported case option.

axes.name: Useful discovery, alternatives, implementation/history and breadth
axes.analysis: Useful non-obvious leads include delayed co-solvent migration, direction-dependent movement, drying/web-position history, permanent-bond replaceability tradeoffs, and separate substrate/printer specification families. Alternatives compare changed paper/system, standardized printing/application, external card/holder, monitoring current labels and measured environmental practice. A dated lot/process/environment chronology and bounded later screen make this more than vacuous caution. A directly matching modern paper-label/sleeve implementation report and actual product history remain unknown; the plan requires looking, not finding a predetermined match. The final records targeted search and does not claim exhaustive absence.

axes.name: Wrong criticism/corrections/rejections and exact-plan dispositions
axes.analysis: All six SCW intended/diagnostic readings were independently adjudicated. The final keeps supported originals and treats neighboring unsupported readings as undetermined, except the rare/high-value/photo recommendation contradicted by the LoC scope. No false scientific correction or unsupported replacement survives. The critic’s full-hour and matching-report findings are qualified: investigator allowance alone is not whole-pipeline occupancy, and the original plan does not require a successful matching report or exhaustive search. Every exact plan clause is assessed below, including authoring/release metadata separately from product obligations.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved across discovery/draft/critique/final
axes.analysis: The final retains the supported mechanism limits, distinct outcomes, material/process/history leads, no-contact alternatives, owner decisions and proposed/unexecuted status. Draft/final explicitly gate annotation copying more clearly than discovery, and the draft replaces discovery’s less discriminating condition list with crossed factors. The final bounds the screen at eight material/printer/application cells. It does drop the draft’s detailed optional controlled stable/variable ordinary-exposure branch; it retains exposure uncertainty and a later approved design, so this is a stated capability/detail limitation rather than a false environmental conclusion or material obligation loss.

axes.name: Proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.analysis: Executed work is desk research/review, not field or material validation. Future checks have empty matching sleeves/coupons, controls/free witnesses, identified compatible crossed factors, runs/lots, randomization, fixed imaging, separate curl/bond/readability/association endpoints, repeat observations, failure denominators and pre-result owner thresholds. Twelve per cell and six months are explicitly feasibility choices, not low-failure acceptance or lifetime proof. Natural locations do not isolate humidity; absent variation, compatibility, traceability or adequate sample size yields inconclusive. LoC modified peel tests and accelerated exposures are not deployed as this case’s oracle. Synthetic handwriting can screen a candidate, not prove preservation of every existing annotation.

limitations.finding: No directly matching modern paper-label/polymer-sleeve implementation report or case-specific manufacturer history is established. A bounded targeted search is documented; this does not prove absence.
limitations.why_not_material: The original plan asks to look for relevant technical descriptions and reports, not produce a predetermined match. Scoped technical/implementation analogues and actionable future record leads exist, and missing identity genuinely blocks a product-specific history.

limitations.finding: LoC 700-703/713 and 714 face-stock options are polymer films, not this case’s paper labels. Candidate summaries omit that construction condition and say face stock is user-selected without spelling out the allowed film choices.
limitations.why_not_material: The final expressly uses procurement/testing analogies, does not name a suitable stock or transfer the prescribed adhesive/test thresholds to paper labels, and keeps construction unknown. The omission weakens source precision and opportunity comparison but changes no consequential product decision.

limitations.finding: NARA displays a May 2, 2023 last-reviewed date despite candidate metadata saying no date is shown; the de Ruvo PDF prints DOI 10.15376/frc.1973.2.785; LoC configuration history is a separate section, and several candidate page/§5.5 history locators are inaccurate.
limitations.why_not_material: Exact source identities remain navigable and the version/application judgments do not depend on these metadata omissions. No conflicting edition or source-condition error alters the final recommendation.

limitations.finding: The final uses natural monitored exposure/location blocks rather than the draft’s optional approved controlled stable/variable ordinary-exposure comparison. Two weeks may miss excursions; six months may miss seasonality.
limitations.why_not_material: The final explicitly limits humidity attribution and treats unobserved exposure as inconclusive. The original plan’s controlled-exposure access remains unresolved and its staged-factor proposal is permissive. This first screen is not misrepresented as an environmental causal test; the dropped optional branch is still a preservation limitation.

limitations.finding: Twelve units per cell across three runs is not an acceptance sample, and synthetic annotations do not validate every historical ink/annotation. Non-adhesive alternatives receive fit/retrieval/association checks but less detailed allocation than the main factorial screen.
limitations.why_not_material: These are feasibility checks with owner-defined tolerance/confidence, existing-annotation safeguards and a separate future approval gate. No unexecuted performance or lifetime result is claimed.

limitations.finding: Nine literal reviser source-map evidence_path entries (S01–S09) point to absent files in reviser/sources. The authored reviser source index explicitly links the existing investigator notes; S10 exists locally.
limitations.why_not_material: The sources are not missing: the complete authored notes and identities were inspected through the index. The independent map records both the invalid literal paths and actual index resolution, without repairing candidate files.
